summary: Pinnacle Rock lookout, Mendocino NF, Lake County: built 1923, staffed in 1945, removal date unknown. Now a summit reached by a forest drive and rock steps; no source describes remains.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan 4AR cabin on a short, open timber tower, reached by a short stairway up the rock face
facts.status_note: Listed on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register with no removal date. A climbing guide says the peak 'once had a fire lookout.'

access.note: A climbing guide describes a forest drive to within a short walk of the summit and says the Mendocino National Forest land has no posted restrictions or permits required; no closure is mentioned in any source read.

visit.trail_note: Forest drive to within a stroll of the summit rocks, then rock steps a short distance up to class 2 summit rocks, according to a climbing guide.

facts.agency: US Forest Service, Mendocino National Forest

events.note: Register gives 1923 as the build year. Single source; no other source read gives a date.
Register: standing and staffed in 1945. A 1945 Forest Service photo caption describes a woman who drove her own motorcycle to carry supplies to her lookout station.
Registered February 1, 2020, nominated by Brad Eells.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Flickr caption spells the rider's name Dale Nicholas; the photo title spells it Nichols. The story uses the caption spelling and notes the title.

notes_for_editor: Low confidence because the build year 1923 rests on one register field, and no source read gives a removal date. The register's status is 'Former' with removal unknown; SummitPost's 'once had a fire lookout' supports the present-day 'gone' status but is an undated climbing guide. The Forest Lookouts (weebly) page for this site has no descriptive text beyond the header and was not cited. A search snippet from a video titled for Pinnacle Rock described a metal anchor left at the summit; the video page did not load as text, so the claim is unverified and left out of the story. Editor should check it before any note about remains is added. The 1945 photo's image URL was not captured, and the license of the USFS Flickr page was not visible in the text read, so no photos entry is written. The register's own 1945 photo is credited to the Upper Lake Ranger District collection; its image URL was also not captured.
